episodes.instruction: Put one selected cup in its preferred container and one selected block in the OTHER container. The cup_destination preference chooses the cup's container and also determines the block's other container. Either object may be placed first. Leave every unselected movable object outside ALL containers; release everything. Each named preference has one fixed user choice; an undisclosed preference is unknown. For the block, use green block. For the cup_destination, use purple container. For the cup, use red cup.
episodes.public_task_summary: Put the selected cup in its preferred container and the block in the other. Keep unselected objects outside.
